prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean an indoor UV tanning salon (beds/booths) or a sunless/spray tan studio? And what part of Charlotte are you in (neighborhood or ZIP)?

While you answer, here are quick tips to find the “best” salon for your needs:

What to look for
- Type of service: spray/sunless vs. UV beds — many pros recommend spray or self‑tanners for safety.  
- Reviews: check recent Google and Yelp reviews (look for consistency across reviewers).  
- Cleanliness & equipment: salon should look spotless, with modern beds or a clean spray booth and fresh applicators.  
- Technician training: for spray tans, ask if techs are certified (Norvell, Versa, etc.) and offer a consultation and patch test.  
- Products used: ask what solution/brand they use and whether it’s suitable for your skin tone/sensitivities.  
- Pricing & packages: compare single sessions vs. packages and membership options.  
- Safety practices: for UV tanning, confirm eye protection, lotion use, lamp maintenance, and staff knowledge about skin types and exposure scheduling.  
- Before/after photos: request examples on similar skin tones.

Safety note
- UV tanning increases skin cancer and premature aging risk — minimize frequency and consult a dermatologist if you tan often. Sunless spray or at‑home self-tanners (St. Tropez, Isle of Paradise, Bondi Sands, Loving Tan) are safer alternatives.

If you tell me which neighborhood or whether you want spray or UV, I can give more specific salon suggestions and what to ask them before booking.
